newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RANDGOLD DROPS ON MINE CLOSURE NEWS.
newsitem.headline: RANDGOLD DROPS ON MINE CLOSURE NEWS.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd dropped sharply on Monday following news that its East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd (ERPM) has decided to cease operations at its Benoni Gold Mining Co Ltd as soon as possible due to the slide in the gold price.
By 1050 GMT Randgold had dropped 245 cents, or 12.28 percent, to 17.50 rand, while East Rand fell seven cents to 120 cents.

The firm said the decision was prompted by the prevailing low gold price and operating losses incurred by the company over the past two months. It added that management and labour are currently engaged in negotiations to discuss the implications of this decision.
"Everyone knows that that marginal mines will come under pressure if the gold price continues to drop and this is the first one to go," said one dealer.
The gold price has suffered another bout of selling over recent days, dropping to fresh twelve year lows around $318 an ounce.
The news has badly hit local gold shares and the all gold index earlier shed 3.13 percent, or 29.8 points, to 922.3 -- its lowest level since February, 1993.
